**Fujin:** Much time has passed since I last emerged here.

**Fujin:** This was once a lively place, filled with the aroma of incense... Then, the three of us could travel freely across the mountains and rivers.

**Fujin:** Yes... Those days were like flowing water 'neath the moon, dark, yet sparkling oh so brightly...

**Fujin:** Ah, but enough reminiscing.

**Fujin:** Thanks to you all, I am now able to return here and host the Rainjade Rite.

**Paimon:** Eh? So... you're that person in the mural?

**Little Mao:** Oh, I get it now! That person... standing on the mountain, hugging that egg, that was you, wasn't it?

**Fujin:** Ah— An egg? Come now, Little Mao, that was precious jade!

**Fujin:** "Casting Rainjade" is a ritual of great power. The Votive Rainjade can calm rivers, improve the weather... But it can also be a thing of death and slaughter. Only the thinnest line separates curses and the adeptal energies that have aided you up till now.

**Fujin:** That is why I must make sure that the Rite does not fall into the hands of those who would do ill. That's why... Ahem, yes, that is correct, one was indeed the figure who "hugged that egg" in that mural.

**Little Mao:** Huh... Big Sis Fujin, doesn't this make you pretty, uh, ancient?

**Fujin:** Yes, it does. Still, I do like the name "Big Sis." It does quite make me feel young!

**Fujin:** I am, in truth, the weakest of my band of friends. I cannot make medicines to save others, nor can I bound across the mountains and plains. Even so, I could not simply lay the title down.

**Fujin:** It would have done the people of Chenyu Vale a disservice, I fear.

**Fujin:** Still, you may call me whatever you wish. After all, we... have become friends, or so I would say.

**Fujin:** In any case, my days of being called an adeptus are now consigned to history, just like this place has been.

**Fujin:** Once, the Rainjade Rite was a day of great celebration, where we would commemorate the year of abundance, using laughter, firecracker battles, and beast dances to frighten the ill omens away. This must appear like naught but forgotten ruins to the modern mind.

**Little Mao:** That's right, we're on an adventure together!

**Fujin:** Right... Yes, you're right! Thank you — that was well said! Indeed. I was the one who asked you all for help. It wouldn't do at all if I just continued wallowing in the past, now would it?

**Fujin:** In any case, I'll need your help to prepare for the Rite itself.

**Fujin:** In any case, have you encountered any Sacred Simulacra in your adventures? Those were ritual spirits often used by people in ancient times to protect their homes. There should be some nearby.

**Fujin:** Traveler, Paimon, Little Mao, please help me put the Simulacra in their proper places. That way, we can restore the spirit veins using the Rainjade Rite.

**Little Mao:** So, this is how we met...

At that time, I was still a little kid who didn't know anything about the mountains. It was nighttime, and some wild beasts were following me through the forest. It was super scary!
Finally, I was chased to a clearing, and surrounded by those beasties. For a moment, I was convinced I was gonna get eaten, but suddenly, they all backed off into the woods, and then they were gone.

When I looked back, there she was, looking at me. She was like jade, but there was a dignity to her.
I knew it then, that she was the master of the mountain that my grandparents had told me about. I wasn't scared. I just told her...
